name: Giãn đồng tử
description: Phân tích phản ứng và mẫu giãn nở đồng tử
mechanism: Analyzes giãn đồng tử patterns to detect AI-generated content. Phân tích phản ứng và mẫu giãn nở đồng tử
parameters: Analysis type: sensor, Media: video, Confidence threshold: adaptive
accuracy: Moderate to High — 65-85% standalone, higher when combined with other methods
source: Research-based sensor analysis method for video forensics
useCase: Detection of AI-generated video through giãn đồng tử analysis
strengths:
• Effective sensor analysis technique
• Works well as complementary method
• Applicable to various video types
• Based on established research
limitations:
• May require sufficient video quality
• Best used in combination with other methods
• Performance varies with content type
